# Additions to Esther Chapter 5 (Addition E) — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther E | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_005_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition E: The counter-decree issued by Artaxerxes authorizing the Jews to defend themselves and annihilate their enemies. Inserted after Hebrew Esther 8:12.]*

**5:1** The following is a copy of the letter: "The Great King Artaxerxes to the rulers of the provinces from India to Ethiopia, one hundred and twenty-seven provinces, and to those who-are well-disposed toward our affairs — greeting.

**5:2** Many of-the more-frequently-honored by-the overly-great kindness of their benefactors grew arrogant and sought not-only to-oppress those-under-our-rule but, being-not-able to-bear the-abundance, even against the-ones-who-did-good to them they-were-attempting to-plot.

**5:3** Not only have-they driven-out gratitude from among men, but also, puffed-up by the-boastings of those-who-know-nothing of goodness, they-supposed they-were-able to-escape the-judgment ever-watchful of God who-hates-evil.

**5:4** And often-times many of those-set in-places of authority were-made-guilty by having-been-persuaded, by the-words of friends-entrusted-with their affairs, to-participate in the-blood of-the innocent, and were-involved in misfortune through the-malice of deceit.

**5:5** But one-may observe the-lies of-the ill-disposed men not so-much in the-ancient stories transmitted to us, as by searching out the-things-that-have-been-done wickedly even in-the recent [past] under your-own eyes,

**5:6** and to-guard better for the-future, that we-may-render the-kingdom undisturbed and peaceful for all men,

**5:7** by making changes, and judging what-is always brought to-our attention always with more-equitable rendering-of-judgment.

**5:8** For Haman son-of Hammedatha, a Macedonian in-truth, and foreign to the-Persian blood, and far-removed from our-goodness, having-entertained-as-a-guest, enjoyed the kindnesses which we-have toward every nation to-such-a-degree as to-be-called our father and to-be-reverenced by all as second after the-royal throne,

**5:9** was-unable to-restrain his arrogance, and sought to-deprive us of-our kingdom and our life.

**5:10** Through certain fabrications of-deceit and tricks he-sought the-destruction of Mordecai, our savior and perpetual-benefactor, and of Esther, the-blameless partner-of-our-kingdom, along with all-their nation.

**5:11** For by these-things he-thought, when we-were-left without friends, to-place into the-power of-the Macedonians.

**5:12** But we-find the-Jews, not evil-doers but governed by most just laws,

**5:13** and being-sons of-the Most High, the-great living God, who-has-directed the-kingdom both for us and for our-fathers in the-most-excellent manner.

**5:14** You-will-do well therefore not to-give effect to-the letters sent by Haman son-of Hammedatha,

**5:15** because he-himself who-acted these-things has-been hanged at the-gates of Susa with all his household — God who-rules-over-all having-quickly given to him the-worthy judgment.

**5:16** This letter, which-has-been sent by them, you-must publish everywhere,

**5:17** and allow the-Jews to-use their own customs, and to-help them, that on that same day, the thirteenth of-the twelfth month that-is Adar, they-may-defend-themselves against those-who-attack them at the-time of-their-affliction.

**5:18** For God the-ruler-of-all has-changed this day for them, instead of-ruin of-the chosen race, into joy.

**5:19** Therefore among your celebrated feasts, observe also this day with all gladness,

**5:20** so that both now and hereafter it-may-be for us and for those-of-good-mind toward the-Persians salvation, but for those-plotting-against us a memorial of-destruction.

**5:21** And every city or country, whatever things-shall-not-be-done in accordance with these-things, will be utterly-destroyed with fire and wrath; and it-shall-be not-only inaccessible to men but also very detestable even to wild-animals and birds for ever."
